snippet.title: Ace Sponge: The Great SquarePants Chronicles| SpongeBob x Ace Attorney fangame
snippet.description:
Have you ever like Sponge?
Have you had an inkling towards playing blue suit man?
What if you could play as blue suit Spong?

Have a taste of Ace Sponge, a shitpost that refused to leave my system until I finally got it out :DD

Enjoy:  https://fushiyu-ningiyo.itch.io/sponge
